fields.summary: Support KWD and OMR (3dp) for GCC cross-border payments

content.text: As a treasury operator I need to send cross-border payments in Kuwaiti Dinar (KWD) and Omani Rial (OMR) so that the GCC corridor can go live. Both currencies use 3 decimal places (fils / baisa). Raised by po.synthetic@example.com.
AC1: KWD and OMR are accepted currencies with exactly 3 decimal places (1.234 KWD valid).
AC2: An amount with 4 decimal places in KWD or OMR (e.g. 1.2345) is rejected with PRECISION_EXCEEDED.
AC3: Minimum amount is 0.001 KWD / 0.001 OMR; zero and negative amounts are rejected with INVALID_AMOUNT.
AC4: GCC payments are always cross-border; a missing IBAN is rejected with MISSING_IBAN (test IBAN KW81CBKU0000000000001234560101).
AC5: Amounts must be decimal types end to end; no binary floating point anywhere in the flow.
